| # Object 0x13FF safety configuration checksum {#object-0x13ff-safety-configuration-checksum-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Each sub-index contains the CRC about the SRDO communication and mapping parameters for the assigned SRDO.

 

  Index           0x13FF
  --------------- -------------------------------
  Name            Safety Configuration Checksum
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 16
  Category        Optional
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 16
  Default Value   0

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex        00
  --------------- ---------------------------------------
  Description     Highest Sub-Index Supported
  Access          rw(only in NMT Pre-operational state)
  Value Range     1-16u
  Default Value   0x10

 

  SubIndex        01 to 16
  --------------- ---------------------------------------
  Description     Check-sum 1 to 16
  Access          rw(only in NMT Pre-operational state)
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 16
  Default Value   0

 

 

This array shall provide the CRC for each SRDO individually.

The generator polynomial shall be: G(x) = x16+x12+x5+1

Refer CiA-304 for more details on CRC calculation.
